openApi: Two new paths and five new schemas; every existing parsed path and schema unchanged.
scope: Own the legacy Tax-specific readiness rules and provide authenticated, non-persisting generated assessment preview routes over caller-supplied immutable facts. Preserve ordered aggregation and issue codes/messages/source/acceptance.
limits: The preview does not certify stored completeness, company membership, production history, permission or an authority outcome.
Nonfinite monetary preview outputs are explicitly rejected; the underlying pure calculation retains its frozen nonfinite behavior.
No business-data read, durable migration, provider call, SQL cutover or stage exit.
Active web calculations, owned provider workflow and full source-backed filing history still require retirement/integration.
